- finish: 89.3%, median 395s / mean 5815s

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>

- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Home wait-time info (4 wins across 7 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 4 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 6 tests) proved helpful, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Changes to choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in copy (2 tests), and sign-in hints (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout modifications (4 tests) and sign-in notifications (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or degraded performance.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].

"layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: new_screen_pet_visibility_basics
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen after home intro showing users how to locate, minimize, and toggle their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails about pets not displaying on desktop or users not knowing how to control or hide their pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Learn how to summon and control your pet on screen

new_pet_visibility_guide.headline: Finding & Controlling Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_visibility_guide.body: Learn hotkeys to toggle pet visibility, bring your pet to focus, or move it around your desktop anytime.

candidates.title: waiting_render_milestone_info
candidates.change: Displays stage milestone information and estimated time during long pet creation renders.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s). Clear progress context helps set expectations.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.hint: Your custom pet assets and animations are being rendered.

candidates.title: pick_friend_story_preview_flow
candidates.change: Introduces a story preview flow where pet choices are presented within interactive story panels.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s and can cause drop-off; previewing companion storylines makes character selection clearer.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_navigation_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the final onboarding screen around desktop control shortcuts and navigation cards.
candidates.why: Users report confusion post-onboarding about controlling, hiding, or interacting with their pet.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop or use key shortcuts to chat, access settings, or hide the pet anytime.

candidates.title: upload_photos_quality_guidance_flow
candidates.change: Adds explicit photo upload requirements and dynamic preview guidance before custom pet generation.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 tickets where custom pet generation failed or resulted in visual errors due to poor photo inputs.

upload_photos.headline: Photo Upload Guidelines
upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos to ensure accurate desktop pet rendering.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_status_notification
candidates.change: Adds an option on the render wait screen to send a system notification when generation finishes.
candidates.why: The average wait time on the home waiting screen exceeds 35 minutes (2336s), leading users to idle or abandon the application.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

candidates.title: sign_in_cloud_account_hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging into an existing account restores pets and saved data.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) involves users losing or resetting pets after re-authenticating with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your registered email to automatically sync and restore your existing desktop pets.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_desktop_placement_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a desktop placement card layout with preview indicators.
candidates.why: Adoption completion leads directly into desktop rendering, where user drop-off occurs if placement expectations are unclear.

candidates.title: story_welcome_companion_flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the introductory story flow to highlight desktop companion features prior to path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 21.2% with a mean duration of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation or lack of context.

story.headline: Your Virtual Desktop Buddy Awaits
story.body: Discover how desktop pets live right on your screen while you work, study, and play.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_render_progress_checklist
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into a checklist format showing real-time preparation steps.
candidates.why: Home stage has high wait times; dynamic progress indicators reduce perceived wait times and improve completion rates.
